json_patch.value: Fix: fix: replay emits CrewKickoffFailedEvent when the replayed run fails. Target files: lib/crewai/src/crewai/crew.py, lib/crewai/tests/test_crew.py. `Crew.replay`'s execution tail wraps `_execute_tasks` in try/except, emitting `CrewKickoffFailedEvent(started_event_id=self._kickoff_event_id)` before re-raising — mirroring `kickoff()`'s except-clause. (Ref: https://github.com/crewAIInc/crewAI/pull/8418)
